task.title: Resolve a save conflict
task.shortdesc: Recover from a concurrent update or stale tab without silently losing profile changes.

prereq.p: A visible BPM status, validation message, browser warning, or failed action indicates that the current workflow cannot safely continue.

context.p: A save conflict means another tab or session changed the saved profile after the current editor loaded it.

step.cmd: Stop on the save-conflict panel and do not overwrite immediately.

info.p: Expected result: you preserve the profile state and understand the next safe recovery action.

step.cmd: Compare the visible profile name, schema channel, editor mode, and last saved state with the tab that produced the conflict.

info.p: Expected result: you preserve the profile state and understand the next safe recovery action.

step.cmd: Copy any unsaved draft values that must be preserved before reloading the profile.

info.p: Expected result: you preserve the profile state and understand the next safe recovery action.

step.cmd: Reload the profile or retry save only after choosing whether to keep the current draft or the newer saved state.

info.note: Retry only from the BPM interface; do not change profile data outside the application.

result.p: The stale tab is resolved without silently discarding the current draft or the newer saved profile.

postreq.p: If the error repeats, stop the workflow and contact support with the visible message, profile name, schema channel, and current page.
